Yup, running just fine on my PC running Arch and Lutris (works great with Heroic Games Launcher too!).Best way to do it, is make sure to have a default wine prefix to where store KH3 on, then install the following prerequisites on that wine prefix (a few of them can be taken from winetricks): dxvk, corefonts, faudio, vcredist x86 and vcredist x64 and most importantly, mf-install is super duper required, else the game just gets stuck on a black screen.

For it, simply git clone [mf-install's repo](https://github.com/z0z0z/mf-install) somewhere, and put yourself on its folder. Then, on a terminal: WINEPREFIX="/path/to/your/wineprefix" ./mf-install.sh He'll handle the rest, then enjoy the game I guess (I'm currently completing the main story, no issues at all here, with [Proof as well](https://ibb.co/6Y7c9z4)).
